candidate_disposition.ffn_gate_up: DO_NOT_OPEN — exact-shape fused NPU Gate+Up+SiLU is approximately neutral on W-S and only ~1.038x family-level on W-C before any full-system synchronization effects.
candidate_disposition.ffn_down: OPEN_BOUNDED_STUDY — conservative imported-graph provider timing leaves +66.66 ms/token W-S and +24.20 ms/token W-C family budget; model-load-only FP16 representation and compiled-graph import are both feasible.
candidate_disposition.lm_head: NOT_NEEDED_FOR_CURRENT_GATE — Amdahl headroom exists but provider transfer budget was not required once FFN-down passed all gate dimensions.
candidate_disposition.attn_qkv: NOT_NEEDED_FOR_CURRENT_GATE — Amdahl headroom exists but provider transfer budget was not required once FFN-down passed all gate dimensions.

required_successor_constraints: FFN-down only; do not broaden to Gate/Up, LM-head or attention in the same study.
Use exact target real Q4_K and Q6_K FFN-down weights; no random-weight performance claim.
Representation conversion must occur only at model load or offline cache creation; no per-token full-weight repack.
Separate cold graph-import/setup cost from warm per-token transfer/compute cost.
Measure both W-S and W-C or equivalent frozen short/long state contexts.
Do not claim benefit for short cold requests unless setup amortization is explicitly passed.
No canonical integration until a later independent carry-through gate.
scientific_answer: Yes. The host NPU and callable graph provider are operational, the exact FFN-down shape can be represented through a model-load-only FP16 compiled graph, current-canonical Amdahl headroom remains above 1.10x, and measured provider-bound FFN-down latency leaves a substantial positive warm transfer budget. The opportunity is conditional on long-lived/cached session semantics because graph import/setup does not amortize for short cold requests.
